content.short: Metana offers self-paced Web3 bootcamps for Solidity and Rust (24 weeks each) with project-based learning.
content.description: Metana offers self-paced, online Web3 bootcamps with tracks in Solidity and Rust, each lasting 24 weeks. The programs are project-based and conclude with a professional portfolio that learners can share with potential employers. In the Solidity track, you'll study Solidity, DeFi, smart contracts, wallets, Ethereum, NFTs, OpenSea, staking, gas and gas fees, zero-knowledge proofs, and layer 2 technologies. The Rust track covers Rust, dapps, smart contracts, DeFi, GraphQL, and the Anchor framework.
